label: Trump will be known as a wartime president
description: A word said to have been given right before the 2024 election, that Trump will be known as a wartime president, noted against the fact that he came out of the box saying he would be a man of peace and wanted the Nobel Peace Prize.
aliases: I'm going to be a man of peace

label: Headlines in black bold letters: terror in the heartland, nation in turmoil
description: A pair of headline visions replayed from earlier recordings: terror in the heartland with terror striking again in the papers, seen in December, and a nation in turmoil seen in the headlines in black bold letters on May 4th. He says he has an urgency in his heart to tell people they must wake up.
aliases: in the headlines in black bold letters
